description: High fiber, healthy breakfast cookies for those busy mornings where you dont have time to sit and eat a meal. I am obsessed with these lately! Kid friendly too! #momsoftiktok #momtok #breakfast #easyrecipe #cookies #baking #fyp #healthyrecipes #recipes #glutenfree
transcript: All right, let's make some breakfast cookies. So I don't know about you, but my kids, they change what they like to eat in a day on breakfast rotation pretty much every day. And then next up, this is gonna add a bunch of fiber and also makes it more filling. So this is flaxseed meal. We just have half a cup of flaxseed meal. Put that in with our bananas. Then we have three tablespoons of peanut butter. You can use any kind of nut butter that you like. Peanut butter tends to go better with these just because it goes well with banana. So we're just gonna add that to our bowl. And then next up, we just have some dark chocolate chips. I love these lilies, dark chocolate chips. They don't have any added sugar or weird ingredients. So they just go really well for the breakfast cookies. And then we are just going to mix this all together. All right, so we got this all mixed together. It's gonna look like this. Then what we just have is a baking sheet and an ice cream scooper. So we are just going to scoop, probably one scoop's worth on our baking sheet for each cookie and make sure you separate them as they are going to expand. So you might need two baking dishes if you have a small one like me. So we're just gonna place them on here like this. I have my oven preheating at 350. So we're gonna pop those in there for 20 minutes. And then I will show you what we got. All right, and we are back with the final product. They were in the oven for 20 minutes at 350. The whole house smells so good, you guys. These are such a great breakfast option. So here we have the center, nice and gooey filled with chocolate chips. So excited to try these. So good, you guys. This is so good, mama.
